title: Remote viewing Napoleon's 'War of the Rabbits'

tellings.quote: as the carriage went away he was throwing rabbits out the window. He lost the war to the rabbits.

plain: Napoleon once lost a "war" to rabbits, and a remote viewer says he watched it happen with his mind, seeing a carriage drive off while someone threw rabbits out of the window. A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan tells this from his own session. Remote viewing is the practice of trying to see distant places, or here a past event in France, without being there. If it worked, the method could reach back in time.
